text:
incident-bot: Paging oncall: High 5xx+timeout spike observed on gateway -> model-inference-prod (alert 324). 2m error rate > 60 rps. Link: https://grafana.redwood/alerts/324

ashley: ack, oncall infra. seeing elevated 502/503 and lots of backend timeouts. digging in logs now.

leo: I can take runtime lead, pulled logs from model-runner-1..4. getting repeated SIGSEGV in model-runner-worker around kvcache access. attaching snippet.

leo: ```
[14:01:12] worker-3 ERROR RuntimeException: segfault at 0x7f8e2c
stack: run_inference -> kv_cache::get -> attention_kernel::apply
PID 24123 killed by SIGSEGV
```

maria: customer impact: some premium customers reported 502s and missing streaming chunks. Support tickets starting at 14:03. Volume about 0.6% of overall traffic but spikes to 4% in certain regions.

sam: Gateway metrics show 5xx concentrated on region-us-west and traffic routing still sending to the same pool. Suggestions: enable routing fallback to dedicated-pool-2 and throttle concurrency.

ashley: doing two immediate mitigations: 1) reduce max concurrency on model-runner pods from 6 -> 2; 2) enable gateway fallback to dedicated-pool-2 for model-inference-prod.

ashley: commands I ran: ```bash
kubectl -n inference scale deployment/model-runner --replicas=0
# scale down concurrency in runtime config
curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' https://controlplane.redwood/api/v1/pools/dedicated-pool-2/fallback -d '{"enable":true}'
```

leo: Also pushed a quick runtime patch to disable the new attention kernel that appears in the stack (rolling patch to model-runner image tag v3.2.1->v3.1.9). patch deployed to 2/4 pods so far.

gabriel: noticed memory growth preceding crashes in logs. oom_kill not yet recorded but resident set grew to 95% of GPU mem on worker-3. suspect KVCACHE eviction path causing corruption under high concurrency.

sam: gateway fallback is live. traffic shifting now, error rate dropping from 62 rps -> 18 rps within 90s. Latency improving.

maria: support update: told impacted customers we are routing around the faulty pool and investigating root cause. Asking for a timeline for full recovery.

leo: rolling back the new kernel seems to have stopped segfaults on patched pods. still seeing occasional timeouts on older pods; continuing rollout.

ashley: next steps: finish rollback to v3.1.9 across all model-runner pods, leave fallback in place until stable for 30m, capture core dumps and trace for postmortem.

leo: core dump collected from worker-3: /var/crash/model-runner-24123.core. I'll share to the infra-ml channel and start debug.

incident-bot: Incident annotation: first seen 2024-10-12T14:03:19Z, page routed, mitigation in progress.

ashley: handing off to night oncall (leo) in 20m. If error rate remains <5% for 30m, we can move to monitoring-only and open a ticket for RCA.

leo: ack handoff. summary for handoff: root cause suspected: attention kernel regression causing memory corruption under high concurrency -> segfaults -> 5xx cascade at gateway. Live mitigations performed: disable kernel, reduce concurrency, enable pool fallback. artifacts: logs, core dump, patch diff, grafana snapshots.

maria: noted. creating incident ticket INC-2024-324 with customer impact summary, list of actions taken, and owners (leo for debug, ashley for infra follow-up).

sam: once rollout complete and metrics stable, recommend a gradual re-enable test with canary instances (5% traffic) and KV cache stress tests before rolling to prod.

leo: leaving a checklist for night oncall: 1) confirm fallback still active, 2) ensure no remaining segfaults in logs 3) verify GPU mem usage stable 4) coordinate with runtime team for RCA meeting.

ashley: thanks team. marking as high priority but currently mitigated. will update ticket and close page if stable at 15:00 UTC. :thumbsup:

maria: support notified customers with ETA ~2-4 hours for full investigation. will escalate if additional customer impact appears.

gateway-team: adding note: update routing policy to favor dedicated pools for heavy-seq workloads until we ship a tested kernel.

leo: last check at 14:12: error rate 5xx=3 rps, overall p50 latency 120ms, p95 1.1s. continuing to monitor.

ashley: handing off now. leo will be primary. leaving channel open for updates.

leo: acknowleged. signing off to monitor. will post any regressions.
